Medhavi Group Launches New Venture for Education-to-Employment Infrastructure

The Medhavi Group has launched a new initiative named MedhaviOne, aimed at developing India's education-to-employment infrastructure. Amit Haralalka has joined the venture as Co-Founder and CEO. The initiative focuses on bridging the gap between educational institutions and employment opportunities within India.
